title: "Bacterial correlation"
format: html

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Bacterial context analysis for shortlisted fungal and viral taxa
# ============================================================

# This analysis evaluates whether PTB-associated fungal and viral taxa occur
# preferentially within specific bacterial community structures, including CST,
# clustered CST, dominant bacterial species, and bacterial species abundance profiles.

# ----------------------------
# Load required packages
# ----------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

# ----------------------------
# Define project paths
# ----------------------------

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"

data_dir    <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

bacterial_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "bacterial_context")
bacterial_figures_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "bacterial_context")

dir.create(bacterial_results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(bacterial_figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ----------------------------
# Define candidate taxa carried forward from previous analyses
# ----------------------------

fungal_candidates <- c(
  "Aspergillus",
  "Fusarium",
  "Cryptococcus",
  "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces",
  "Trichoderma"
)

viral_candidates <- c(
  "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus"
)

# ----------------------------
# Read metadata using the required format
# ----------------------------

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# The first metadata column contains short plotting labels such as ID_1, ID_2.
# These labels are useful for figures but must not be used for sample matching.
colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

# Ensure BMI is numeric for consistency with previous models.
meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)

# ----------------------------
# Define bacterial context columns from metadata
# ----------------------------

cst_column <- "CST"
cluster_cst_column <- "Cluster_CST"
dominant_species_column <- "Top_Specie"

required_bacterial_context_columns <- c(
  cst_column,
  cluster_cst_column,
  dominant_species_column
)

missing_context_columns <- setdiff(
  required_bacterial_context_columns,
  colnames(meta)
)

if (length(missing_context_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing bacterial context columns in metadata: ",
    paste(missing_context_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Bacterial species abundance/count columns are already present in the metadata.
# They start at Acidaminococcus_intestini and end at Veillonella_sp.
bacterial_start_col <- "Acidaminococcus_intestini"
bacterial_end_col   <- "Veillonella_sp."

if (!bacterial_start_col %in% colnames(meta)) {
  stop("Bacterial start column not found: ", bacterial_start_col)
}

if (!bacterial_end_col %in% colnames(meta)) {
  stop("Bacterial end column not found: ", bacterial_end_col)
}

bacterial_species_columns <- colnames(meta)[
  which(colnames(meta) == bacterial_start_col):
    which(colnames(meta) == bacterial_end_col)
]

bacterial_species_mat <- meta[, bacterial_species_columns]

bacterial_species_mat <- bacterial_species_mat %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

rownames(bacterial_species_mat) <- meta$reads_ID

# ----------------------------
# Read fungal and viral abundance matrices
# ----------------------------

fungal_mat <- read.delim(
  fungal_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

viral_mat <- read.delim(
  viral_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Remove trailing _1 from sequencing IDs before metadata matching.
fungal_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(fungal_mat))
viral_ids_clean  <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(viral_mat))

# ----------------------------
# Align fungal matrix with metadata
# ----------------------------

fungal_unmatched <- setdiff(fungal_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)

if (length(fungal_unmatched) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Unmatched fungal samples found: ",
    paste(fungal_unmatched, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

meta_fungal <- meta[
  match(fungal_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
]

if (!all(meta_fungal$reads_ID == fungal_ids_clean)) {
  stop("Fungal metadata order mismatch.")
}

rownames(fungal_mat) <- fungal_ids_clean
rownames(meta_fungal) <- meta_fungal$reads_ID

# ----------------------------
# Align viral matrix with metadata
# ----------------------------

viral_unmatched <- setdiff(viral_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)

if (length(viral_unmatched) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Unmatched viral samples found: ",
    paste(viral_unmatched, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

meta_viral <- meta[
  match(viral_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
]

if (!all(meta_viral$reads_ID == viral_ids_clean)) {
  stop("Viral metadata order mismatch.")
}

rownames(viral_mat) <- viral_ids_clean
rownames(meta_viral) <- meta_viral$reads_ID

# ----------------------------
# Keep only candidate taxa present in each matrix
# ----------------------------

fungal_candidates_present <- intersect(fungal_candidates, colnames(fungal_mat))
viral_candidates_present  <- intersect(viral_candidates, colnames(viral_mat))

missing_fungal_candidates <- setdiff(fungal_candidates, colnames(fungal_mat))
missing_viral_candidates  <- setdiff(viral_candidates, colnames(viral_mat))

write.csv(
  data.frame(missing_fungal_candidates = missing_fungal_candidates),
  file.path(bacterial_results_dir, "missing_fungal_candidates.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(missing_viral_candidates = missing_viral_candidates),
  file.path(bacterial_results_dir, "missing_viral_candidates.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# Helper function for group-based non-parametric testing
# ----------------------------
run_group_tests <- function(mat, meta_aligned, taxa, group_column, domain_name) {
  
  summary_results_list <- list()
  pairwise_results_list <- list()
  
  for (candidate_taxon in taxa) {
    
    df <- data.frame(
      reads_ID = rownames(mat),
      sample_label = meta_aligned$sample_label,
      outcome = meta_aligned$outcome,
      group = as.character(meta_aligned[[group_column]]),
      candidate_taxon = candidate_taxon,
      abundance = as.numeric(mat[, candidate_taxon]),
      presence = ifelse(as.numeric(mat[, candidate_taxon]) > 0, 1, 0)
    )
    
    df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(group))
    
    if (length(unique(df$group)) < 2) {
      next
    }
    
    kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(abundance ~ group, data = df)
    
    prevalence_table <- table(df$presence, df$group)
    
    fisher_result <- tryCatch(
      fisher.test(prevalence_table),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    group_summary <- df %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        domain = first(domain_name),
        taxon = first(candidate_taxon),
        n_samples = n(),
        n_detected = sum(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        prevalence = n_detected / n_samples,
        median_abundance = median(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_abundance = IQR(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        grouping_variable = group_column,
        kruskal_p = kruskal_result$p.value,
        fisher_prevalence_p = ifelse(
          is.null(fisher_result),
          NA_real_,
          fisher_result$p.value
        )
      )
    
    summary_results_list[[candidate_taxon]] <- group_summary
    
    pairwise_test <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
      x = df$abundance,
      g = df$group,
      p.adjust.method = "BH",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    pairwise_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(pairwise_test$p.value)) %>%
      rename(
        group_1 = Var1,
        group_2 = Var2,
        pairwise_wilcox_p_adj = Freq
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        domain = domain_name,
        taxon = candidate_taxon,
        grouping_variable = group_column
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(pairwise_wilcox_p_adj))
    
    pairwise_results_list[[candidate_taxon]] <- pairwise_df
  }
  
  summary_results <- bind_rows(summary_results_list)
  pairwise_results <- bind_rows(pairwise_results_list)
  
  if (nrow(summary_results) > 0) {
    summary_results <- summary_results %>%
      group_by(domain, grouping_variable) %>%
      mutate(
        kruskal_q = p.adjust(kruskal_p, method = "BH"),
        fisher_prevalence_q = p.adjust(fisher_prevalence_p, method = "BH")
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
  
  return(
    list(
      summary = summary_results,
      pairwise = pairwise_results
    )
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Test candidate taxa across CST groups
# ----------------------------

fungal_cst_results <- run_group_tests(
  mat = fungal_mat,
  meta_aligned = meta_fungal,
  taxa = fungal_candidates_present,
  group_column = cst_column,
  domain_name = "Fungal"
)

viral_cst_results <- run_group_tests(
  mat = viral_mat,
  meta_aligned = meta_viral,
  taxa = viral_candidates_present,
  group_column = cst_column,
  domain_name = "Viral"
)

# ----------------------------
# Test candidate taxa across clustered CST groups
# ----------------------------

fungal_cluster_cst_results <- run_group_tests(
  mat = fungal_mat,
  meta_aligned = meta_fungal,
  taxa = fungal_candidates_present,
  group_column = cluster_cst_column,
  domain_name = "Fungal"
)

viral_cluster_cst_results <- run_group_tests(
  mat = viral_mat,
  meta_aligned = meta_viral,
  taxa = viral_candidates_present,
  group_column = cluster_cst_column,
  domain_name = "Viral"
)

# ----------------------------
# Test candidate taxa across dominant bacterial species groups
# ----------------------------

fungal_top_species_results <- run_group_tests(
  mat = fungal_mat,
  meta_aligned = meta_fungal,
  taxa = fungal_candidates_present,
  group_column = dominant_species_column,
  domain_name = "Fungal"
)

viral_top_species_results <- run_group_tests(
  mat = viral_mat,
  meta_aligned = meta_viral,
  taxa = viral_candidates_present,
  group_column = dominant_species_column,
  domain_name = "Viral"
)

# ----------------------------
# Combine and save group-based results
# ----------------------------

group_summary_results <- bind_rows(
  fungal_cst_results$summary,
  viral_cst_results$summary,
  fungal_cluster_cst_results$summary,
  viral_cluster_cst_results$summary,
  fungal_top_species_results$summary,
  viral_top_species_results$summary
)

group_pairwise_results <- bind_rows(
  fungal_cst_results$pairwise,
  viral_cst_results$pairwise,
  fungal_cluster_cst_results$pairwise,
  viral_cluster_cst_results$pairwise,
  fungal_top_species_results$pairwise,
  viral_top_species_results$pairwise
)

write.csv(
  group_summary_results,
  file.path(bacterial_results_dir, "candidate_taxa_bacterial_context_group_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  group_pairwise_results,
  file.path(bacterial_results_dir, "candidate_taxa_bacterial_context_pairwise_wilcoxon.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# Create plotting dataframe
# ----------------------------

fungal_plot_df <- fungal_mat[, fungal_candidates_present, drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    reads_ID = rownames(fungal_mat),
    sample_label = meta_fungal$sample_label,
    outcome = meta_fungal$outcome,
    CST = meta_fungal[[cst_column]],
    Cluster_CST = meta_fungal[[cluster_cst_column]],
    Top_Specie = meta_fungal[[dominant_species_column]]
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(fungal_candidates_present),
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(domain = "Fungal")

viral_plot_df <- viral_mat[, viral_candidates_present, drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    reads_ID = rownames(viral_mat),
    sample_label = meta_viral$sample_label,
    outcome = meta_viral$outcome,
    CST = meta_viral[[cst_column]],
    Cluster_CST = meta_viral[[cluster_cst_column]],
    Top_Specie = meta_viral[[dominant_species_column]]
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(viral_candidates_present),
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(domain = "Viral")

candidate_plot_df <- bind_rows(fungal_plot_df, viral_plot_df)

write.csv(
  candidate_plot_df,
  file.path(bacterial_results_dir, "candidate_taxa_bacterial_context_plotting_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot candidate taxa by CST
# ----------------------------

plot_by_cst <- ggplot(
  candidate_plot_df %>% filter(!is.na(CST)),
  aes(x = factor(CST), y = abundance)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
  facet_grid(domain ~ taxon, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Bacterial community state type",
    y = "Relative abundance",
    title = "Candidate fungal and viral taxa across CST groups"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(bacterial_figures_dir, "candidate_taxa_by_CST_boxplots.png"),
  plot_by_cst,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(bacterial_figures_dir, "candidate_taxa_by_CST_boxplots.pdf"),
  plot_by_cst,
  width = 12,
  height = 7
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot candidate taxa by dominant bacterial species
# ----------------------------

top_species_to_keep <- candidate_plot_df %>%
  count(Top_Specie, sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Top_Specie)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Top_Specie)

plot_by_top_species <- ggplot(
  candidate_plot_df %>%
    filter(Top_Specie %in% top_species_to_keep),
  aes(x = Top_Specie, y = abundance)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
  facet_grid(domain ~ taxon, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Dominant bacterial species",
    y = "Relative abundance",
    title = "Candidate fungal and viral taxa across dominant bacterial species"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(bacterial_figures_dir, "candidate_taxa_by_Top_Specie_boxplots.png"),
  plot_by_top_species,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(bacterial_figures_dir, "candidate_taxa_by_Top_Specie_boxplots.pdf"),
  plot_by_top_species,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)


cst_heatmap_df <- group_summary_results %>%
  filter(grouping_variable == cst_column) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_label = paste(domain, taxon, sep = ": "),
    group = as.character(group),
    median_abundance = as.numeric(median_abundance)
  ) %>%
  group_by(taxon_label, group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_abundance = median(median_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = median_abundance,
    values_fill = list(median_abundance = 0)
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(cst_heatmap_df) <- cst_heatmap_df$taxon_label
cst_heatmap_df$taxon_label <- NULL

# Force all columns to numeric
cst_heatmap_df[] <- lapply(cst_heatmap_df, as.numeric)

cst_heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(cst_heatmap_df)

# Replace any missing values with zero
cst_heatmap_matrix[is.na(cst_heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

# Remove taxa with no variation across CST groups
# These create NaN values when rows are scaled
row_sds <- apply(
  cst_heatmap_matrix,
  1,
  sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cst_heatmap_matrix_filtered <- cst_heatmap_matrix[
  row_sds > 0 & is.finite(row_sds),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Save PNG heatmap
png(
  file.path(
    bacterial_figures_dir,
    "candidate_taxa_median_abundance_by_CST_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 2200,
  height = 1400,
  res = 300
)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cst_heatmap_matrix_filtered,
  scale = "row",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "Median candidate taxon abundance by CST"
)

dev.off()

# Save PDF heatmap
pdf(
  file.path(
    bacterial_figures_dir,
    "candidate_taxa_median_abundance_by_CST_heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cst_heatmap_matrix_filtered,
  scale = "row",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "Median candidate taxon abundance by CST"
)

dev.off()

# Save list of taxa removed from clustering
removed_taxa <- names(row_sds)[
  row_sds == 0 | !is.finite(row_sds)
]

write.csv(
  data.frame(taxon_removed = removed_taxa),
  file.path(
    bacterial_results_dir,
    "heatmap_removed_zero_variance_taxa.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# Save session information for reproducibility
# ----------------------------

sink(file.path(bacterial_results_dir, "session_info_bacterial_context.txt"))
sessionInfo()
sink()
```
